content.title: Frequently Asked Questions
content.text: TICKETING Q. When will I receive my tickets? A. Digital tickets purchased on SeatGeek.com will be available no later than 30 days from the start of the event. Tickets can be viewed using The PGA Championships App, available in the Apple and Google Play stores. Tickets can also be accessed using the SeatGeek app or website. All mobile ticket barcodes will refresh every few seconds to keep tickets safe and secure. Q. How do I access my mobile tickets? A. Tickets can be accessed using The PGA Championships App, available in the Apple and Google Play stores. Tickets can also be accessed using the SeatGeek app or website. All mobile ticket barcodes will refresh every few seconds to keep tickets safe and secure. A PDF or screenshot will not be accepted. Note: For a seamless experience, we recommend ticket holders have the app downloaded and the ticket(s) available on their device before attending. Q. How do I transfer my mobile tickets? A. Tickets will become transferable at a later date determined by the PGA. Ticket communications and updates will be sent to the email used to purchase tickets. Tickets can be transferred using The PGA Championships App, available in the Apple and Google Play stores. Tickets can also be accessed by visiting My Tickets on the SeatGeek app or website. Select the tickets you want to send and click Send. Then enter the name, username, email or phone number you are sending tickets to. Click Quantity and select the number of tickets that you want to send and finally tap Send. Linked here is a step by step video. Q. Can I print my tickets at home? A. No. Printed tickets will not be accepted at the PGA Championship. If you are having difficulty accessing your mobile ticket on your day of attendance, please have your order number and email address handy and visit the Ticket Office located at the Main Spectator Entrance. Q. Can I have multiple tickets on the same mobile device? A. You can view all active tickets in your account using The PGA Championships App, available in the Apple and Google Play stores beginning in mid-April. You can also visit the My Tickets section of the SeatGeek app or website. It is highly encouraged that you transfer a ticket to each member of your party to allow for the easiest entry and access into the Championship. Q. What if my guests and I are arriving at the Championship separately? A. If arriving separately, you can transfer a ticket to each member of your party in advance. This will allow you and your guest(s) to arrive at your convenience. Tickets can be transferred using The PGA Championships App, available in the Apple and Google Play stores. Tickets can also be accessed by visiting My Tickets on the SeatGeek app or website. Tap Send next to the tickets you want to share. Enter the recipient’s email or phone number. Q. What if I purchased tickets from an entity other than the PGA? A. If your ticket was purchased from a secondary market website other than PGAChampionship.com or SeatGeek, we are unable to assist or verify the authenticity of those tickets. Purchasing from unauthorized third-party sellers is discouraged as any duplicate or fraudulent tickets will be denied from admission. Please only accept tickets from people you know and trust. Q. I purchased tickets, but can no longer attend. Where can I go to sell my tickets? A. Ticket resale will be available no later than 60 days prior to the event. If available, tickets can be sold by visiting My Tickets on the SeatGeek app or website. Tap Sell next to the tickets you want to get off your hands. Set your price, sit back and relax.Please note that the 1896 Experience ticket packages cannot be resold. Q. What if I don’t have a smartphone? A. A digital ticket is the only form of entry, but if you don’t have access to a smartphone, please visit the Ticket Office near the Main Spectator Entrance with a copy of your order confirmation and a license matching the name on the ticket order. Q. How many tickets may I purchase within a single order? A. You may purchase up to eight (8) tickets per championship round (Monday through Sunday) of any unique ticket type within a single order. Q. Do you have a policy for juniors? A. Juniors 15 years of age and younger will be admitted into the PGA Championship grounds for FREE when accompanied by a ticketed adult. Each ticketed adult will be permitted two (2) junior grounds admissions per day at no additional charge. Junior tickets may be picked up onsite at the Ticket Office at the Main Spectator Entrance on the day of admission. Junior tickets cannot be obtained in advance and will be available regardless of a sellout.All individuals, regardless of age, must have a hospitality ticket to enter any hospitality venue/area; complimentary junior grounds tickets do not include hospitality access.PGA of America reserves the right to request proof of age (e.g., valid student ID) at the point of Junior Ticket redemption and to deny entry to the PGA Championship to anyone who violates or attempts to violate the Junior Admission Policy. Q. Do you have a policy for members of the military? A. To honor the men and women who serve our country in the Armed Forces, the Championship is pleased to offer Active Duty, Retirees, Reserve, Veterans, and National Guard and their accompanying guest (limit one and subject to availability) complimentary daily grounds access to the Championship.The PGA of America works with GOVX, where a copy of a Military ID must be provided in exchange for daily admission.Step 1: Register for tickets through GOVX, https://offers.govx.com/event/offers/, registration does not guarantee tickets.Step 2: A code will be sent to the email provided. That code must be used on SeatGeek.com or the SeatGeek mobile app to claim tickets. SeatGeek is the Official Ticketing Provider of the PGA of America.Please note: Thursday - Sunday military tickets have sold out and are no longer available. Monday - Wednesday tickets remain, subject to availability. Q. I registered for Military tickets. How will I receive them? A. Military Tickets are digital and will appear in your SeatGeek ticket account on the morning of the event. The military member and accompanying guest must arrive together, with tickets on the same mobile device.Military tickets must be claimed in advance via GOVX and will not be offered day of at the Box Office.Military ticket support will be available at the Ticket Office at the Main Spectator Entrance. Please bring a copy of your Military ID if you need assistance accessing your SeatGeek account. Q. Are tickets personalized? Can I give my ticket to a family member or friend? A. Tickets may be transferred to another person. However, each ticket may only be scanned at the gate once. Q. Can I come and go from the PGA Championship with my same ticket? A. No same-day re-entry is permitted. Once scanned, your ticket is expired. Q. What is your refund policy? A. Unless otherwise determined by PGA Tournament Corporation or The PGA of America, in their sole discretion, there shall be no refunds, rainchecks, exchanges or replacements of tickets except as provided for in the following Event Cancellation / Weather Policy outlined in the full Championship ticket terms and conditions. Q. I am looking for Official PGA Championship Travel Packages to include tickets, accommodations, and transportation arrangements. A. Official 2026 PGA Championship ticket, experience, and hotel packages will become available soon from On Location, the Official Travel Package Provider of the PGA of America. Click here to explore On Location ticket and travel packages. Q. How do I make changes to my order? A. Once an order has been placed, you cannot go back into your account and edit it on your own. If you have made a mistake or would like to edit your order, please contact our support team at pgaofamerica@seatgeek.com, and they can assist you depending on the situation. Q. I’m not sure if the order I just placed went through. How can I find out if it did? I don’t want to place a duplicate order. A. If you reached a confirmation page that displayed an order number, or received an order confirmation email, the order was processed correctly. Sometimes order confirmation emails can be delayed up to 2 hours, so if there is any confusion, please contact our support team at pgaofamerica@seatgeek.com, and they will assist you. Q. Where do I go for ticket purchase support, such as if my order is failing to process or I didn’t get an email order confirmation? A. Please contact the SeatGeek support team for the PGA of America at 888-601-5229 or via email at pgaofamerica@seatgeek.com for ticket order support. SeatGeek is the Official Ticketing Supplier of the 2026 PGA Championship. Q. How do I change the email address on my SeatGeek account? A. Please contact the SeatGeek support team for the PGA of America at 888-601-5229 or via email at pgaofamerica@seatgeek.com for ticket order support. SeatGeek is the Official Ticketing Supplier of the 2026 PGA Championship. Q. Do infants require their own ticket? A. Children under the age of 2 do not require an admission ticket to enter the Championship. Q. I am looking for a premium, all-inclusive hospitality experience. Is there an option for me? Premium hospitality packages are sold out. Daily Club PGA hospitality tickets are available in limited quantities. Act now to secure your tickets.You can purchase Daily PGA hospitality tickets here Q. What is a Club PGA Ticket? A. Club PGA is the perfect venue for entertaining small groups of customers, family, or friends. Enjoy a premium experience overlooking Aronimink's 8th & 10th Greens with chef-inspired menus and an open bar. Club PGA will feature multiple TV’s to keep up with the action on the course, an open-air deck with views of multiple holes, air/heat, executive restrooms, Wi-Fi, stylish décor, and more.You can Purchase Club PGA tickets here Q. What is a Championship+ Ticket? A. The Championship+ Grounds Ticket offers access to the grounds of Aronimink Golf Club and the PGA Championship’s unique Food & Non-Alcoholic Beverage Program, an inclusive offering affording convenience, flexibility, and value. Each time a Championship+ Ticket holder visits a concession venue they will receive one (1) entrée item, one (1) snack item, and one (1) non-alcoholic beverage. Championship+ Ticket holders can also access all public grandstand seating, The PGA Shops presented by Chase Sapphire, and other spectator amenities.You can purchase Championship+ tickets here Q. Will Parking be Available A. Operational plans are still being developed for the Championship. We will provide more information once those plans are finalized. Q: I am a homeowner near Aronimink Golf Club. Can I rent my home during the week of the Championship? A: Yes, homeowners can take advantage of the opportunity to rent their homes to professional golfers, sponsors, and corporate groups for the week of the 2026 PGA Championship through Rent Like A Champion.Rent Like A Champion is the largest vacation home rental website specifically for sporting events nationwide and the preferred rental platform for the PGA Championship. It is free to list a house on the Rent Like A Champion website, and properties of all sizes are encouraged to rent.Rent Like A Champion Home Rental Process:• Visit RentLikeAChampion.com• Click “List Your Home” on the top right-hand corner of your screen• Follow the steps to list your home• Add Photos & Pricing
